dialogue.speaker: scp096
dialogue.text: I am SCP Zero Nine Six.

dialogue.speaker: scp096
dialogue.text: See my face, and nothing stops me.

dialogue.speaker: medusa
dialogue.text: One gaze turns monsters to stone.

sentences.speaker: scp096
sentences.text: I am SCP Zero Nine Six.

sentences.speaker: scp096
sentences.text: Four pixels seal your fate.

sentences.speaker: scp096
sentences.text: See my face, and nothing stops me.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: I am Medusa, cursed Gorgon.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: One gaze turns monsters to stone.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: Look once, and freeze.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A fugitive soldier glimpsed four cursed pixels, fleeing into misty ruins to hide.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Medusa glided from the shadows, turning the intruder into a screaming stone statue.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Seconds later, a deafening shriek split the woods as Zero Nine Six smashed inside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Its target was already marble, yet Medusa looked straight into the monster's face.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Both curses ignited at once as Zero Nine Six unhinged its jaw and charged.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Grey stone crept across its flesh, yet Zero Nine Six shattered the crust.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Spreading golden wings, Medusa soared high, raining bronze claws and living serpent venom.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Shredded and bleeding, Zero Nine Six refused to fall, tearing stone from the earth.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It yanked the Gorgon from the sky and crushed her against the marble.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Golden wings broken, the mortal Gorgon stared straight into death's unhinged jaw.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Trapped beneath its claws, Medusa poured all of her curse into one gaze.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: Turn to stone!

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Emerald fire swallowed the shriek, locking pale flesh into solid rock.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Breathing hard among rubble, Medusa rose before the newest statue in her garden.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: No beast escapes my gaze.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: Not even you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Yet stone only freezes flesh, and Zero Nine Six's bones cannot break.

sentences.speaker: scp096_whisper
sentences.text: Four...

sentences.speaker: scp096_whisper
sentences.text: pixels...

sentences.speaker: scp096_whisper
sentences.text: left.
